# Protected paths: grep -E regexes, one per line, matched against repo-relative
# paths. Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# Agents are refused edits to these paths (PreToolUse hook); pre-commit and
# CI block them unless PROTECTED_OVERRIDE=1 (a human's reviewed change, or a
# PR that already carries gate:plan-approved).

# Guardrails: the checks themselves, their wiring, and the policies they enforce.
^agent/hooks/
^agent/policies/
^\.githooks/
^\.github/workflows/
^\.claude/settings\.json$

# Generated by the Specify CLI. Refresh with `specify integration upgrade
# <harness> --force`; never edit in place. (.specify/memory/ is ours to edit.)
^\.specify/(scripts|templates|integrations|workflows)/
^\.specify/(integration|init-options)\.json$
^\.(claude|agents|devin)/skills/speckit-
^\.opencode/commands/speckit\.

# Generated by loom from .mcp.json, .claude/settings.json and
# agent/tools/loom.config.json. Change the sources, rerun agent/tools/loom.sh.
^\.codex/
^\.devin/(config|mcp_config|hooks\.v1)\.json$
^opencode\.json$
^agent/harness-specs/GAPS\.md$
